summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT) with hands-on embedded software development and verification experience across STM32, Raspberry Pi, and NVIDIA Jetson platforms. Skilled in Python scripting, bare-metal C/C++, and root-cause analysis of real-time embedded systems, resolving hardware/software integration failures across sensor, firmware, and networking layers. Experienced validating robotic hardware end-to-end, from firmware-level cross-checks against physical hardware to field trials measuring pick and trajectory reliability.

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Developed a Python scripting-based GUI (PyQt, Matplotlib) for real-time data acquisition and experimental visualization in a laboratory environment.
Used GitLab for version control and JupyterHub for collaborative data analysis and technical documentation.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% by tuning PyTorch preprocessing and training pipelines for structured-field extraction.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Trained YOLOv8n on 1,133 annotated images achieving 83% mAP@50 on held-out validation; exported to ONNX and TFLite for mobile deployment.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Led a 25-member robotics team across national-level competitions, owning mechanical design, PCB fabrication, and AI/ML integration end-to-end.
Designed and fabricated custom single-layer PCBs in EAGLE for locomotive robots; implemented sensor communication over UART and I2C with closed-loop feedback.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Diagnosed and resolved 11 hardware/software integration failures via systematic root-cause analysis across a three-layer distributed robotic pipeline (Jetson+Arduino controller, Flask-SocketIO edge server), achieving 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials).
Implemented two-link inverse kinematics on Arduino in C++, driving five servos with range-gated contact detection validated via dual VL53L0X ToF sensors over a TCA9548A I2C mux.
Deployed the Jetson-side arm bridge as a Linux systemd service (auto-restart with backoff, non-root isolation) with static IP networking for reliable multi-device field operation.

projects.name: STM32 Bare-Metal Temperature Monitor
bullets: Developed and verified Cortex-M4 bare-metal C firmware for a temperature-monitoring system, programming GPIO, TIM2, ADC1, and I2C1 peripherals directly.
Cross-checked functional behavior in Proteus simulation against physical hardware to confirm deterministic 1 Hz sampling at 3.68 KB Flash / 1.58 KB RAM.

projects.name: ROS-Based Robotic Arm (AL5B & UR5e)
bullets: Derived and validated full forward-kinematic chains for a 6-DoF UR5e and 5-DoF AL5B against MoveIt/RViz URDF models in ROS 2 Humble and ROS Noetic.
Planned and executed collision-free pick-and-place trajectories on physical UR5e hardware; measured AL5B repeatability at <2 mm over 10 trials.
